svg.desc: Fourteen selected disclosed ownership relationships in three separately dated panels. Ownership bands are ranges. Every selected relationship reports control yes, separately from percentage ownership. Corporate identity joins remain unresolved. See evidence-map.md.

Bands cannot be multiplied into an exact personal stake. Acquired-status dates are not verified transaction or employment dates.
The MEB INC / MEB NY INC identity join is unresolved. Registry identifiers remain provisional and are omitted. Inferent is unverified and unconnected.
Scout schedule bands differ from other historical narratives; dates remain unresolved. Ophir CEO/CCO acquired field does not independently date CCO duties.
